name: Existing saved pause survives expanded transition library
description: Existing pause data is kept after additional presets are installed.
covers: saved pause title duration and sound
setup: In F02 save an existing Comedy freeze with a custom caption and duration.
steps: Refresh Final Cut and select F02.
Inspect the selected effect and all saved settings.
expected: The original Comedy freeze remains selected with its previous title, duration and accent.

name: Punch zoom, glitch and reaction stamp are distinct animated effects
description: Different original graphics animate from the footage without changing the scene's character.
setup: Import a five-second rendered Higgsfield MP4 in F03.
steps: Change to Mini glitch and preview.
Choose Reaction stamp, adjust intensity and preview.
expected: All three look different; no video file is rewritten; intensity persists.

name: Presentation and comic pauses remain after their scenes and before intro
description: The official intro stays correctly placed after F02 and newly selected effects render on the episode timeline.
steps: Choose a Type-on title pause for F02.
Preview assembled cut and export on a supported browser.
expected: The type-on title appears after F02 and before the 5-second intro, and renders as video frames in the export.

name: Soft flash, slide and news ticker do not change original audio
description: More visual variety without replacing spoken audio files.
steps: Select Soft flash, Side slide and News ticker one at a time and preview each.
expected: All options are selectable and animated; source dialogue audio is unchanged.
